# Third-party code in this folder

`silktide-consent-manager.js` and `silktide-consent-manager.css` are the
Silktide Consent Manager v2.0.1, unmodified.

- Project: https://silktide.com/consent-manager/
- License: MIT, per the project's documentation

The `LICENSE` file in this folder is Silktide's, copied from their official
repository at the v2.0.1 tag. It has to stay with these files.

Do not edit these two files. All Tukios behavior lives in
`../tukios-consent.js`, so a Silktide update is a file swap.
